task.title: Upgrade source/search to crawler-indexer platform baseline
task.summary_zh: 把 source/search 從 bounded connector/indexer 推到下一層 platform：crawler/indexer policy registry、connector lifecycle、scheduled refresh、license/rate/PIT/audit guard，以及 durable-only search cutoff。
acceptance: connector registry supports bounded crawler adapters with allowlists and rate limits
index refresh is scheduled and materialized without query-time request documents
search durable-only mode has staging/prod cutoff tests
BFF exposes crawler/indexer health and freshness without direct documents compatibility as normal path
task.next: Closeout complete: approved crawler/indexer wave2 delivered in commit 32433b86. Verification: focused source/search/BFF pytest 69 passed; git diff --check passed; py_compile passed for source_ingestion, search scheduler, and BFF touched modules.
review_notes_zh: 審查通過：policy_registry 硬編碼 bounded=True、allowlist_enforced、rate_limit/license guards；scheduler_worker 實作 scheduled refresh + materialize，request_documents_compat=False；durable-only cutoff 有四個 test 加 prod env 斷言；BFF /operator/source/ops 和 /operator/search/ops 透過 service client 暴露 freshness/health，無 direct document reads
後續追蹤：owner 完成 closeout commit 後 push 到 upstream

handoffs.message: Implemented crawler/indexer wave2 baseline: source policy registry and per-connector crawler policies, connector lifecycle audit/disabled run gate, scheduled search refresh/materialize worker in compose, BFF policy/freshness surfaces, and SD-03 update. Verification: /tmp/pantheon-svc-source-search-venv/bin/python -m pytest focused 71 passed; broader source/search regression 86 passed; git diff --check and py_compile passed. Ready for Claude review.
